title: Interface C v1: settings and corrections (both directions)
description: One document, used in both directions: the agent sends changes made on the PC, the backend sends changes made on the dashboard. Spec: FR-28 (pause tracking, hide apps/sites, correct labels, delete by date or all), FR-8 (corrections saved as personal rules, applied to past and future), FR-4 (retention 30 days, user-configurable), FR-3 (idle threshold, default 3 minutes), FR-21 (nudge snooze / turn off), 'What We Store' (Rules, daily goal, Account + settings in the cloud). Decision note website-activation.md (terms version and accepted-at). The CONSENT record is NOT in this document: consent stays local and is never synced.

revision.description: Increases by 1 with every accepted change of this document. A writer must base its change on the latest revision it has seen; on a mismatch the receiver rejects and the writer re-reads and merges. Conflict handling is OQ-C1.

retention_days.description: How long raw events stay on the PC. Default 30. The 1 to 3650 range is the agent's current choice, not the spec's: OQ-C5.

idle_threshold_seconds.description: No input for this long means away. Default 180. The 30 to 3600 range is the agent's current choice: OQ-C5.

paused.description: Pause tracking (FR-28). Whether the dashboard may also resume tracking remotely is OQ-C3.

excluded_apps.description: Executable names the user chose to hide, for example keepass.exe (FR-28). Sending these to the cloud is OQ-C2.

excluded_sites.description: Domains the user chose to hide (FR-28), domain only, never a full URL. Sending these to the cloud is OQ-C2.

nudges.description: FR-21: snoozable and can be turned off. 'Off by default after 2 ignores' is decided by the agent and written here as enabled=false.

daily_goal.description: The user's goal for the day (FR-12). Where the 'auto-suggested goal from history' is produced is OQ-C7.

rules.description: Personal rules from user corrections (FR-8). Deleted rules stay as tombstones (deleted=true) so the deletion also reaches the other side. 'Apply to all similar' means the agent relabels past events locally and re-uploads the affected hours (OQ-A3).

pattern.description: What to match. For title_contains this is text the user chose from their own window titles, so it can be sensitive: OQ-C2.

deletion_requests.description: Delete by date range or all (FR-28; 'one click, no dark patterns'). Each request is applied on the PC (raw events and local summaries) and in the cloud (summaries). Exact scope and acknowledgement are OQ-C6. Optional.

account.description: Written by the backend only; the agent never sends it and the backend ignores it from the agent. Lets the agent notice that the website terms changed (decision note website-activation.md). Optional.
